conf.comment:
cisco_ise → Cortex XSIAM passthrough.
Preserves _raw; XSIAM parses vendor format natively. Tags __sourceIdentifier (+ __vendor/__product when needed).
--- STEP 1: Reduction — drop noise events (disabled by default, enable in Cribl UI to activate) ---
